author: ScantSolid
quote: I just played GTA 5 last month and the only positive thing I can about GTA 6 is that the graphics are much improved. After 13 years, that's all they managed. Still 30 FPS or much lower when it actually matters. These games are always the same, remove the monotonous driving and the rest is just overwhelming amounts of scripted dialogue. This is game is not made for it's original core audience. It's despicable what this company has turned into. I won't elaborate because otherwise this review will probably get deleted like the thousands of others that already have been.
